dek: During the World Robot Conference, a new member of the Tiangong robot family made its debut: Tiangong Omni, a lightweight humanoid just 1.35 meters tall and weighing 39 kilograms. Its slim body suits narrow-space operations, emergency rescue, and home service, and at the show it demonstrated a smooth crawling advance.
